timeout_semantics: unknown; never cancel accepted custody or infer absence
p2_wait_derivation: p2_quiesce_wait_seconds = source_quiesce_deadline_seconds + 30 (the caller outlasts the effect's own budget, so a timeout here is the effect's verdict and never ours); p2_admission_wait_seconds = source_custody_query_seconds (the mailbox admission wait is the custody query budget). Both are caller-side waits: they bound waiting, never custody or execution.
